_comment: Local-engine turns (docs/Local-Engine-Turns.md): the codes the runtime writes, the controller keeps and Studio words, and one lane job's payload, named once. runtime-contracts (claude_code_lane.rs) checks NOT_READY_REASONS, PROGRAM_NOT_READY_REASONS, RUNTIME_FAILURE_CODES, STOP_AND_SWEEP_FAILURE_CODES, CAPABILITY_VERSION and MAX_LOGINS against notReadyReasons, programNotReadyReasons, runtimeFailureCodes, stopAndSweepFailureCodes, capabilityVersion and maxLogins. The controller keeps the reasons and runtime codes as its own lists (runtime/register.rs, claude_code_lane.rs) and checks its stop and sweep codes against the third (claude_code_lane.rs, runtime/sweeps.rs); runtime-agent checks NotReadyReason and FailureCode (claude_code/mod.rs); Studio checks runtimes.ts, claudeCodeCopy.ts and claudeCodeTurnPresentation.ts. laneJobPayload is the payload dispatch writes for a turn of an agent whose AI is Claude Code, the first in its chat: the controller's test a_lane_job_payload_is_the_one_runtime_contracts_records dispatches it to the sender's own @octo set to Claude Code and compares, and runtime-agent's lane tests run it through LaneJob::of (claude_code/job.rs). Its ids are placeholders: <project_id>, <user_id> (the sender), <conversation_id>, <prompt_id>, <run_id> and <agent_id> (the sender's own @octo). It names no runtime: a send whose every agent uses Claude Code has none until one of its person's computers leases its turn. capability is a version 2 `claudeCode` capability as a runtime with two Claude Code logins reports it and registration keeps it (docs/Local-Engine-Turns.md 11.19): the controller's attestation keeps it unchanged, runtime-agent's capability builder gives that shape, and Studio's runtimes.ts reads both logins from it.
